milestones.title: Append-only global memory store and derived workspace projections exist
milestones.goal: The system has one authoritative append-only memory substrate under ~/.mu/wiki/ and can derive per-workspace projections without relying on a write-managed index as the source of truth.

verification.expect: Targeted store/projection tests prove append-only authority and correct derived workspace projections.

verification.command: Review the memory store and projection implementation against SPEC.md and write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review confirms append-only authority and derived workspace projection boundaries, or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Assert that projections can be rebuilt from authoritative entries alone and that no write-managed index file is required as source of truth.
verification.expect: Assertions prove projections are derived rather than authoritative.

verification.command: Run the real CLI in temp workspaces and inspect the visible startup/retrieval surface for a workspace-specific projection after seeding deterministic memory fixtures.
verification.expect: The visible CLI surface shows workspace-specific derived memory context rather than requiring direct raw-store inspection only.

milestones.notes: This milestone closes only after the core append-only model and derived workspace views are proven by tests, review, and assertions.

milestones.title: Durable artifact-producing tool completions append memory automatically
milestones.goal: Completed edit/apply_patch/write operations and artifact-producing bash runs append durable memory entries, while non-durable or no-artifact activity does not.

verification.expect: Targeted trigger tests prove automatic writes happen only for the approved durable tool completions.

verification.command: Review artifact-trigger behavior against SPEC.md and write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review confirms the trigger surface is limited to durable artifact-producing tool completions, or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Capture before/after memory-store fixtures for edit/apply_patch/write/bash scenarios and assert writes appear only in the approved cases.
verification.expect: Diff evidence and assertions prove the automatic-write policy is scoped correctly.

verification.command: Run the real CLI through deterministic edit/apply_patch/write/bash scenarios and inspect the visible transcript/log surface to confirm durable artifact actions produce memory updates while non-artifact actions do not.
verification.expect: The visible CLI surface and captured evidence agree with the narrow artifact-triggered automatic-write policy.

milestones.notes: This milestone closes only after automatic writes are shown to be explicit, narrow, and artifact-based.

milestones.title: Explicit memory tools and fresh-session retrieval are proven through the real CLI surface
milestones.goal: The model can explicitly store/search/read memory through stable memory tools, and `mu exec --json` proves write-then-fresh-session-retrieve behavior with workspace-first projection semantics.

verification.expect: Targeted memory-tool and fresh-session tests pass for explicit store/search/read plus workspace-first retrieval.

verification.command: Review the memory tool surface and fresh-session retrieval flow against SPEC.md and write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review confirms explicit memory requests use the memory tool boundary and that fresh-session retrieval semantics are correct, or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Run real `mu exec --json` flows in temp workspaces: first store memory, then start a fresh session and retrieve it, and inspect the visible CLI behavior.
verification.expect: The real CLI surface proves persistence across fresh sessions and workspace-first retrieval behavior.

verification.command: Assert from captured exec JSON output and/or test hooks that explicit user-requested store operations used the memory tool boundary and that retrieval in a fresh session returned the expected value.
verification.expect: Assertions prove the stable memory-tool boundary and the fresh-session retrieval contract.

milestones.notes: This milestone closes only after the tool boundary and fresh-session retrieval contract are proven through tests, review, and the real CLI surface.
